SELECT p.id, p.user_id, u.username, u.real_name, u.phone, u.title, u.hospital, u.department, p.position, p.specialty, p.license_no, p.license_type, p.practice_scope, p.cert_no, p.issuing_authority, p.license_expire_date, p.introduction, p.experience, p.schedule, p.registration_fee, p.max_patients, u.status, p.update_time FROM doctor_profile p INNER JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = p.user_id AND u.deleted = 0 WHERE p.deleted = 0
AND u.real_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.realName}, '%')
AND u.phone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.phone}, '%')
AND p.license_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.licenseNo}, '%')
AND p.id IS NOT NULL
AND 1 = 0
AND u.status = #{query.status}
ORDER BY p.update_time DESC, p.id DESC

SELECT p.id, u.id AS user_id, u.username, u.real_name, u.phone, u.title, u.hospital, u.department, p.position, p.specialty, p.license_no, p.license_type, p.practice_scope, p.cert_no, p.issuing_authority, p.license_expire_date, p.introduction, p.experience, p.schedule, p.registration_fee, p.max_patients, u.status, p.update_time, CASE WHEN p.id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS has_profile FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN doctor_profile p ON p.user_id = u.id AND p.deleted = 0 WHERE u.deleted = 0 AND u.id = #{userId}

SELECT p.id, p.user_id, u.username, u.real_name, u.phone, u.title, u.hospital, u.department, p.position, p.specialty, p.license_no, p.license_type, p.practice_scope, p.cert_no, p.issuing_authority, p.license_expire_date, p.introduction, p.experience, p.schedule, p.registration_fee, p.max_patients, u.status, p.update_time, 1 AS has_profile FROM doctor_profile p INNER JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = p.user_id AND u.deleted = 0 WHERE p.deleted = 0 AND p.id = #{id}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN p.id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS profiled, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN p.id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS unprofiled, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN p.schedule IS NOT NULL AND p.schedule != '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS scheduled FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN doctor_profile p ON p.user_id = u.id AND p.deleted = 0 WHERE u.deleted = 0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_role x INNER JOIN sys_role r2 ON r2.id = x.role_id AND r2.deleted = 0 WHERE x.user_id = u.id AND r2.role_key = 'DOCTOR')

SELECT u.id, u.real_name AS name, u.title, u.department FROM sys_user u WHERE u.deleted = 0 AND u.status = 1 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_role x INNER JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = x.role_id AND r.deleted = 0 WHERE x.user_id = u.id AND r.role_key = 'DOCTOR') ORDER BY u.id
